title: Envelope
description: Every frame is one JSON object with this envelope. Receivers ignore unknown fields.

id.description: Message id: c_ + ULID from the console, n_ + ULID from the daemon.

seq.description: Only on reliable messages: monotonically increasing per sender within one node.

Ack.title: Ack
Ack.description: Cumulative ACK: every reliable message with seq <= N has been durably processed. Sent at least every 200 ms or every 50 messages.

ApprovalAck.title: ApprovalAck
ApprovalAck.description: The daemon applied approval.resolve (stale = the pending request no longer existed).

ApprovalCancel.title: ApprovalCancel
ApprovalCancel.description: A pending approval went away; the console marks the card cancelled.

ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest
ApprovalRequest.description: canUseTool / Codex requestApproval needs a decision.

suggestions.description: SDK PermissionUpdate[], stored verbatim and returned on allow_always.

message.description: Shown to the model on deny.

OpenGen.title: OpenGen
OpenGen.description: How many times the session has been opened; +1 on every resume.

ImageRef.title: ImageRef
ImageRef.description: An image the user attached to a message (at_attachments). The daemon downloads it with GET <console>/nodes/attachments/<id> and its node token, then hands it to the runtime: Claude gets an image content block (a document block for a PDF), Codex a localImage input item (a PDF is saved and its path named in the text).

CallId.title: CallId
CallId.description: Platform tool call id: tc_ + ULID, generated by the daemon.

UploadId.title: UploadId
UploadId.description: File upload id (up_ + ULID), generated by the daemon.

RelPath.title: RelPath
RelPath.description: Path relative to the daemon root; never absolute.

PermissionMode.title: PermissionMode
PermissionMode.description: Claude permission mode; always explicit. The console opens writing members in bypassPermissions (with allow_dangerously_skip_permissions) or default (ask roles), and the coordinator, lead and read-only roles in dontAsk. auto is kept for old consoles only.

CredRequest.title: CredRequest
CredRequest.description: Credential helper asks for a short-lived token. Unreliable, retried after 10 s with the same req_id; never logged.

CredResponse.title: CredResponse
CredResponse.description: Token for a cred.request, or a refusal. Unreliable; never logged.

ref_id.description: Envelope id of the offending message.

FileChunk.title: FileChunk
FileChunk.description: One piece of a file upload (publish_file). Chunks are sent before the tool.call that references their upload_id; the console keeps them until that call assembles them.

index.description: 0-based position of this chunk in the upload (all files concatenated in tool.call upload.files order).

GitCleanup.title: GitCleanup
GitCleanup.description: Remove worktrees (keeping unpushed work when asked) and prune.

GitPrepare.title: GitPrepare
GitPrepare.description: Clone the shared repo and/or add the worktree (architecture.md 8.1). Idempotent.

base.description: Branch to create from when branch does not exist yet.

GitPurge.title: GitPurge
GitPurge.description: Delete a whole project directory, or one thread's directory (projects/<pid>/threads/<no>, thread deleted), once no session is active there.

GitPush.title: GitPush
GitPush.description: Push an employee branch of one repository with a one-job write token; refspec target must be refs/heads/thread/<thread_no>/<employee>.

force_with_lease.description: Expected remote sha; only for member branches after conflict repair.

unchanged_against.description: Branches (thread branch, base) whose commits are not the employee's work: when HEAD has no commit outside them the push is skipped and the result says unchanged.

created.description: git.prepare: the worktree/clone was created by this job.

unchanged.description: git.push: nothing to push (no commits outside unchanged_against); head_sha is the checkout's HEAD.

GitStatus.title: GitStatus
GitStatus.description: Report branch/ahead/behind/dirty state of a checkout.

Hello.title: Hello
Hello.description: First frame from the daemon after connecting.

protocols.description: Supported protocol versions, highest priority first.

epoch.description: Outbox epoch; changes only when the state directory is wiped.

last_seq.description: Highest seq sent in this epoch.

acked_cmd_seq.description: Highest console command seq executed and persisted.

features.description: Feature names, e.g. sessions, codex_app_server, git_worktree, cred_helper, upgrade.

Log.title: Log
Log.description: Daemon log line, warn and above only; unreliable.

NodeConfig.title: NodeConfig
NodeConfig.description: Settings changed on the node page, pushed immediately.

NodeDrain.title: NodeDrain
NodeDrain.description: Stop accepting new sessions and park idle ones (maintenance).

NodeStats.title: NodeStats
NodeStats.description: Every 30 s, unreliable; drives the server-room rack lights.

NodeUpgrade.title: NodeUpgrade
NodeUpgrade.description: Upgrade the daemon. The download URL is fixed: <console>/node/dist/agent-teams-node-<version>.tgz; sha256 and the Ed25519 release signature are verified.

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature of the tgz.

NodeUpgradeResult.title: NodeUpgradeResult
NodeUpgradeResult.description: Upgrade failure report (success shows up as a reconnect with the new version).

forget.description: Also delete the local session record (SDK transcript is kept 7 days).

SessionDelivered.title: SessionDelivered
SessionDelivered.description: session.send was pushed into the session.

SessionEvent.title: SessionEvent
SessionEvent.description: Session activity event; which fields are present depends on kind (protocol.md 4.8).

tools.description: turn_started: tool list from this turn's init, re-checked by the console.

text.description: text: assistant text, truncated to 8 KB.

category.description: tool_started: edit | read | shell | web | platform | other.

summary.description: tool_started / tool_ended: secret-free summary (Bash command truncated to 200 chars).

usage.description: turn_ended: token usage as reported by the runtime.

todos.description: todos: the employee's whole checklist after a TodoWrite (latest state).

plan.description: plan: the Markdown plan of an ExitPlanMode call, truncated to 32 KB.

queued_msg_ids.description: Messages still queued in the SDK, mapped back to msg_id.

tools.description: SDK options.tools; [] means no built-in tools.

allow_dangerously_skip_permissions.description: Required for bypassPermissions and session.set_mode to bypassPermissions.

read_only.description: Lead and read_only roles: enables bash_policy and a sandbox without writable paths.

deny_non_platform_tools.description: Coordinator: PreToolUse hook rejects everything except mcp__platform__*.

BashPolicy.title: BashPolicy
BashPolicy.description: argv-parsed allow list for read-only sessions (not regex).

config.description: Extra thread/start config (e.g. sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots); mcp_servers.platform is filled in by the daemon.

images.description: Images to deliver with the text (at most 8).

files.description: Text files of the skill; SKILL.md is required.

path.description: Relative path inside the skill directory.

version.description: Library version number (1, 2, …); the directory is <name>@<version>.

files.description: Every file of the package, .claude-plugin/plugin.json included.

skills.description: Qualified names (<plugin>:<skill or command>) to add to options.skills.

mcp_servers.description: The plugin's MCP servers by name; ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is replaced by the plugin directory.

path.description: Relative path inside the plugin directory; '.' and '..' segments are refused.

encoding.description: utf8 (default) or base64 for binary files.

SessionOpen.title: SessionOpen
SessionOpen.description: Open (or resume) a long-lived employee session on the node.

prepare.description: Key of the git.prepare job that must have succeeded first.

prepare_jobs.description: Every git.prepare job (one per repository) that must have succeeded first; prepare is the first of them.

env.description: Extra non-secret environment; the daemon adds PATH/HOME/MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT/git credential variables itself.

git_credentials.description: Install the credential helper and gh wrapper.

skills.description: Skills of the employee's role. Claude: the daemon writes them as a local plugin outside the worktree and loads it (options.plugins + options.skills). Codex gets them in developer_instructions instead.

plugins.description: Plugins ticked on the employee's role, each at an exact version (architecture.md §6.5). The daemon writes each into a per-employee directory outside the worktree. Claude: loaded with options.plugins (skipMcpDiscovery), skills lists the plugin's skills and commands, and mcp_servers join options.mcpServers as plugin_<plugin>_<server>. Codex: only mcp_servers are used (the skill text is already in developer_instructions).

commands.description: Slash commands the session offers besides Claude Code's own (role skills, plugin skills and commands), from initializationResult().commands without the builtin ones. Absent for Codex.

resume_failed.description: resume could not find the transcript/thread; the console runs the hand-over flow.

SessionRelease.title: SessionRelease
SessionRelease.description: Tool check passed: the daemon may push first_message and queued messages for this open_gen.

SessionSend.title: SessionSend
SessionSend.description: Deliver a message to the employee.

images.description: Images to deliver with the text (at most 8).

SessionSetMode.title: SessionSetMode
SessionSetMode.description: Change permission mode and/or model of a session.

SessionWatch.title: SessionWatch
SessionWatch.description: Turn stream.delta on/off while someone watches live output.

SessionsReport.title: SessionsReport
SessionsReport.description: Sessions currently present on the node; the orchestrator reconciles against it.

StreamDelta.title: StreamDelta
StreamDelta.description: Unreliable token stream, only while session.watch is on; not stored.

chunks.description: Number of file.chunk frames (0 when every file is empty).

path.description: Path inside the published deliverable (index.html for a site's entry, or the file name).

ToolCall.title: ToolCall
ToolCall.description: An employee called a platform tool.

tool.description: Platform tool name without the mcp__platform__ prefix.

args.description: Tool input; validated by the console against /protocol/schemas/tools/<tool>.json.

tool_use_id.description: Claude tool_use_id or Codex item id, for diagnostics only.

upload.description: Files the daemon read for publish_file; their bytes arrived before as file.chunk frames.

ToolCancel.title: ToolCancel
ToolCancel.description: A blocking tool call was abandoned (interrupt, close or process restart).

ToolResult.title: ToolResult
ToolResult.description: Result of a tool.call; ok=false becomes an MCP isError result.

structured.description: Optional structured result matching the tool result schema; null when the tool only returns text.

Welcome.title: Welcome
Welcome.description: Console reply to hello: negotiated protocol and node settings.

protocol.description: Highest version in both protocols lists.

ack_seq.description: Highest daemon seq the console has durably processed (same epoch; 0 when the epoch changed).

min_daemon.description: Older daemons get node.upgrade or close code 4426.

AskLeadInput.title: AskLeadInput
AskLeadInput.description: Ask the thread lead a question and wait for the answer.

AskUserInput.title: AskUserInput
AskUserInput.description: Ask the user a question (a card on the web page). Either a plain question (question + optional options) or up to 4 structured questions (questions: each with a short header, 2-4 options with a description, one may be recommended, multi_select for several answers; the user can always type their own answer instead). Members block until the user answers and get the answer back; the coordinator and leads get the question id at once and receive "[Answer to q5] ..." as a later message. Give question or questions.

question.description: A plain question (use questions for choices with descriptions).

options.description: Suggested answers shown as buttons (with question).

questions.description: Structured questions shown as one card, like Claude Code's AskUserQuestion.

via.description: Set by the platform when Claude's built-in AskUserQuestion is routed here (the call then blocks for every tier). Do not set it yourself.

AssignSubtaskInput.title: AssignSubtaskInput
AssignSubtaskInput.description: Create a subtask of your current task for a teammate (instance or role name); returns the task id at once. Only for roles with can_delegate.

pooled.description: true when assigned to a role (task pool).

AssignTaskInput.title: AssignTaskInput
AssignTaskInput.description: Create a task under a main task. assignee is an instance name (dev-2) to assign directly, or a role name (dev) to put it in the task pool where the first free instance claims it.

main.description: Title of the main task (plan step) this belongs to.

repo.description: Repository the task is about (owner/name); named in the task text. With base, records the thread's base branch in it.

base.description: Base branch the thread uses in repo (only before the thread branch exists there; read the project context for stated bases).

BroadcastInput.title: BroadcastInput
BroadcastInput.description: Send a message to every member of the thread.

CancelTaskInput.title: CancelTaskInput
CancelTaskInput.description: Cancel a task that has not finished.

TaskOutcome.title: TaskOutcome
TaskOutcome.description: Final state of a task that was waited on.

answer.description: Present when the call blocked until answered.

answers.description: Structured questions: the user's choice per question, in order (present when the call blocked until answered).

question.description: The complete question, ending with a question mark.

header.description: Very short label shown as a chip (max 12 characters).

options.description: 2-4 distinct choices; an "other" free-text answer is always offered, do not add one.

multi_select.description: Let the user pick several options.

recommended.description: Mark the option you recommend (at most one per question).

other.description: The user's own answer typed into 其他.

CompleteTaskInput.title: CompleteTaskInput
CompleteTaskInput.description: Finish your current task explicitly; the platform pushes your branch first. Use status failed when you cannot finish it.

artifacts.description: Paths, commit SHAs or URLs produced by the task.

EnqueueMergeInput.title: EnqueueMergeInput
EnqueueMergeInput.description: Put a member branch into the merge queue, one entry per repository the task pushed (merged into the thread branch on GitHub, then CI). Give either member or task_id.

repo.description: Merge only this repository of the task (default: every repository the task pushed).

base.description: Base branch the thread uses in repo (only before the thread branch exists there; read the project context for stated bases).

FinishInput.title: FinishInput
FinishInput.description: Write the thread summary; it is also added to the project memory. With code changes, call it after open_pr: the thread ends when the PR merges. A thread that changed no repository (research, review, Q&A) needs no PR: finish ends it right away (done).

GetTaskInput.title: GetTaskInput
GetTaskInput.description: Show a task: instruction, status, dependencies and result.

ListTasksInput.title: ListTasksInput
ListTasksInput.description: List the thread's tasks with assignee, main task, kind and status.

ListTeamInput.title: ListTeamInput
ListTeamInput.description: List the thread team: name, role, type, node and current task of each member.

ListThreadsInput.title: ListThreadsInput
ListThreadsInput.description: List threads, one line each: number, title, status, main-task progress and how many items wait for the user.

MemoryDeleteInput.title: MemoryDeleteInput
MemoryDeleteInput.description: Delete a project memory topic file and its line in MEMORY.md (MEMORY.md itself cannot be deleted).

MemoryListInput.title: MemoryListInput
MemoryListInput.description: List the project's memory files (MEMORY.md and topic files) with their descriptions.

MemoryReadInput.title: MemoryReadInput
MemoryReadInput.description: Read one project memory file in full (MEMORY.md or a topic file listed in it).

MemoryWriteInput.title: MemoryWriteInput
MemoryWriteInput.description: Create or replace a project memory file. A topic file (e.g. testing.md) needs a one-line description; the platform keeps its line in MEMORY.md. name MEMORY.md rewrites the index itself.

MessageThreadInput.title: MessageThreadInput
MessageThreadInput.description: Send a message to a thread's lead as the project coordinator.

pr_number.description: First pull request of the thread.

prs.description: Every pull request of the thread, one per repository.

OpenPrInput.title: OpenPrInput
OpenPrInput.description: Open one pull request per repository the thread changed (thread branch to that repository's base branch); the thread moves to review. Only for code changes: a thread that changed nothing ends with finish alone.

repo.description: Open only this repository's pull request (default: every changed repository without one).

base.description: PR base branch for repo (or for the only repository to open); default the thread's base there.
Base branch for this repository; default its default branch.

OpenThreadInput.title: OpenThreadInput
OpenThreadInput.description: Open a new thread (number, branch, member instances) for a piece of work; the brief becomes the lead's first message. Returns #no immediately.

roles.description: Role names to staff the thread with; default = all member roles of the team.

repos.description: Repositories of the project the thread should work in, with an optional explicit base branch each (when the project context states one).

PublishDeliverableInput.title: PublishDeliverableInput
PublishDeliverableInput.description: Register a deliverable link for the project (doc, design, slides, dashboard, board, data...). PRs are registered by the platform.

kind.description: Known: pr, doc, design, slides, dashboard, board, data; anything else is shown as a link.

PublishFileInput.title: PublishFileInput
PublishFileInput.description: Publish a file you made (HTML prototype, Markdown doc, SVG, image, PDF, JSON, CSV) as a project deliverable. The platform uploads it from your working directory and hosts it; people view it on the Deliverables page and their comments come back to you as messages. A directory with index.html is published as a small site. Pass deliverable_id to publish a new version of an earlier deliverable.

path.description: File (or directory with index.html) inside your working directory, relative to it.

kind.description: design for prototypes and visual designs, doc for documents and specs; also slides, dashboard, board, data.

deliverable_id.description: An earlier deliverable of this project published with publish_file; the file becomes its next version.

head_sha.description: Head of the first pushed repository ("" when nothing was pushed).

PushBranchInput.title: PushBranchInput
PushBranchInput.description: Push the HEAD of each of your repository checkouts that has new commits to your member branch (thread/<no>/<name>). You have no write token yourself; commit first, then call this.

ReadMessagesInput.title: ReadMessagesInput
ReadMessagesInput.description: Return your unread messages (including broadcasts) and mark them read.

RememberInput.title: RememberInput
RememberInput.description: Append a one-line note to the project memory index MEMORY.md (shortcut for small facts).

ReplyToInput.title: ReplyToInput
ReplyToInput.description: Answer a member's question ("[Question q3 from dev-1 ...]"). Answer quickly: the member is blocked until you do.

ReportProgressInput.title: ReportProgressInput
ReportProgressInput.description: Report progress on your task (shown in the thread activity).

RequestReviewInput.title: RequestReviewInput
RequestReviewInput.description: Ask a teammate to review your work (creates a review task under your current task) and wait for the result. You cannot ask yourself.

ReviewPermissionInput.title: ReviewPermissionInput
ReviewPermissionInput.description: Decide a member's permission request ("[Permission request q5 from dev-1 ...]"). allow lets the member run it once, deny refuses it (the reason goes to the member), ask_user hands it to the user. Choose ask_user when unsure, or when it touches secrets, production, money, other people or anything irreversible. Decide quickly: the member waits.

reason.description: One sentence; shown to the user in the thread's activity and on the card.

SendMessageInput.title: SendMessageInput
SendMessageInput.description: Leave a message for a teammate (instance name) or for the lead ("lead"). Busy recipients get it after their current turn.

SetStatusInput.title: SetStatusInput
SetStatusInput.description: Set your speech-bubble text in the office (one short sentence on what you are doing). Call it when you switch work; it does not change your state or position and expires after 10 minutes.

ThreadStatusInput.title: ThreadStatusInput
ThreadStatusInput.description: Show one thread: plan, recent activity, the lead's latest reply and the PR.

UpdatePlanInput.title: UpdatePlanInput
UpdatePlanInput.description: Replace the thread plan (main tasks). Steps are matched by title so existing main tasks keep their ids.

WaitTaskInput.title: WaitTaskInput
WaitTaskInput.description: Wait until one of your subtasks finishes and return its result. Only for roles with can_delegate.
